sample_method: Deterministic SHA-256 ranking with seed 20261107; 25 diagnostic-marker rows plus 75 general rows per direction.
blinding: The packet did not display system identity, but the reviewer knows the project and model; this was not a blinded human review.

rubric.OK: Meaning preserved; differences are stylistic or equally acceptable wording.
rubric.MINOR: Localized error(s); the main meaning remains recoverable without the reference.
rubric.MAJOR: Material meaning loss or distortion, or broken syntax; unreliable without repair.
rubric.CRITICAL: No coherent proposition, unrelated/degenerate output, or a critical detail (negation, number, name) destroyed.

comparison_to_step9500.caveat: Same deterministic sample and rubric, but a fresh single-AI review, not an inter-annotator replicate. The distribution shifted toward both more MINOR and more CRITICAL labels, so the net acceptable count is not a uniform quality gain.

examples.system_output: Il a toujours pris place à la place.
examples.note: Meaning is preserved; pris place a la place is slightly awkward but acceptable.

limitations: Single AI reviewer; no human judgments or inter-annotator agreement.
The packet is a deterministic stratified sample, not a random population audit.
One reference translation per row; other acceptable wordings were not enumerated.
The reviewer was not blinded to the model identity.
Not a safety, legal, bias, or domain-suitability audit.
